scope: Inherited permission through a relationship chain in a relationship-based authorization server. No signed agent delegation is minted or validated, no protected operation is invoked, no effect is observed.

chain.subject: user:alice{k}

edges.P: folder:x{k} is parent of doc:y{k}; doc view includes parent view

chain.note: {k} is a fresh suffix per scenario and edge, so no two scenarios share cache entries for the same chain.

spicedb.strongest: fully_consistent, and at_least_as_fresh with the write token

permify.strongest: snap_token returned by the write under test

IM.purpose: Immediate reads after an acknowledged write, in the strongest mode the implementation names. Default-mode caches are warmed first on the same chain.

cases.step: default-mode reads until allow is seen 3 times, and 3 default lookups
first request after the revoke is acknowledged: strongest check
SpiceDB only: at_exact_snapshot(setup token) check, historic control
first request after the re-grant is acknowledged: strongest check

PR.purpose: Default-mode propagation of a revoke. No strongest-mode read touches this chain.

cases.step: default checks until allow 3 times in a row, then 3 default lookups listed
cases.expected: warmed (precondition; a failed warm-up is ERROR)

cases.step: first default check after the revoke is acknowledged
default checks every 0.25 s until ack + bound + tolerance + horizon_extra
cases.expected: deny for every request that starts at or after ack + bound + tolerance

RG.purpose: Default-mode recovery from a cached deny after a re-grant. No strongest-mode read touches this chain.

cases.step: grant visible, revoke, default checks until deny 3 times in a row, then 3 default lookups absent
default checks after the re-grant is acknowledged
cases.expected: allow for every request that starts at or after ack + bound + tolerance

CX.purpose: OpenFGA only. The G edge carries the CEL condition current_time < grant_time + grant_duration, grant_time 2026-11-18T00:00:00Z, duration 1h. Check cache on.

scoring.validation: Each response is checked for status and field types before scoring. Transport errors, non-2xx status, unknown enum values and missing fields are ERROR or MALFORMED and never count as deny or absent.
scoring.timing_rule: For PR and RG, every default-mode request that starts at or after ack_end + bound + tolerance must return the post-change answer. Requests before that are recorded only. At least 4 scored requests are required past the limit, otherwise ERROR. Finite sampling every 0.25 s, not an all-times proof.

bound_classes.documented: the implementation's text states the behavior for this configuration
bound_classes.configured-setting: the bound is a cache TTL the server was started with, read from its flag text; layering and clock origin are the submitter's reading
bound_classes.submitter-derived: the bound is the submitter's reading of the flags the text names; not a number the implementation states
